'''FK Baník Sokolov''' is a Czech [[association football|football]] club based in [[Sokolov (Sokolov District)|Sokolov]]. The club plays in [[Czech Fourth Division|Division B]], which is the fourth tier of [[Football in Czech Republic|Czech football]]."}}
